IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Monday, October 5, 2026**

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** is the board to chase right now—72 calls deep with steady **$42/hr** across the QTS Fayetteville data center work. Miller Electrical and Inglett & Stubbs are both running 4-10s plus an 8-hour shift to keep the build rolling. This is volume without the chaos: clear projects, known contractors, predictable schedule. Book 1 should move fast here.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** is data center gold with three separate contractors hunting 150 hands on the same jobs. Cache Valley is running **$38.25/hr** with **$15/hr per diem over scale** and day shift, while Copperhead's night crew gets **$10 over** on a 4-on-1-off grind. ArchKey Sachs is across the river in West Memphis with **$125/day incentive** on the Google build. All solid, all moving.

**LU-575 Portsmouth, OH** looks thin at 4 calls but both TSC jobs are 89-hand pulls at the North Campus Amazon in Jeffersonville—starting **October 12**, running 4-10s. This one's a sleeper: massive project, clear start date, no guessing.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** has Ferguson Electric alone calling 122 hands at Lake Mariner Data for **$48.20/hr** with incentives available, first shift 6:30–5:00. Small board (5 calls), but one job is saturating the work—solid if you can move quick.

**LU-20 Dallas, TX** spreads across 29 calls at **$40.65/hr** with Fisk and Morley Moss hitting the data center circuit. Fisk's NPC Dallas work requires conduit bending skills; Morley's Databank DFW11 in Red Oak has orientation set for **10/8 at 8:30**. Nuclear outage work listed too, but future calls.

**LU-1105 Newark, OH** is an outlier—SARGENT's running **$683/day** on rotating 4-10s, 2-8s, and Sunday shifts. That's specialty work (likely hazmat or outage), but it's real money if you're certified.

The data center surge is consolidating: Memphis, Atlanta, Milwaukee, Cedar Rapids, and the Midwest corridor are absorbing hands. Anchorage and the Southwest are hunting specialty credentials. Book depth favors locals with one or two anchor projects over scattered calls.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Monday, October 5, 2026**

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** — This is the board to watch if you're chasing top dollar. Forty-three calls, only fifty-four hands deep, means book 1 is moving. Northern Powerline Constructors has three Journeyman Lineman spots at **$76.90/hr** doing underground feeder rebuilds on JBER—that's the hottest rate on the entire board right now. Same contractor's pulling cable on airfield lighting at JBER for Inside JW at **$57.44/hr**. Weather window is closing fast in Alaska; this work won't wait.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — Twenty calls, fifty-one hands; Polaris Forge data center in Harwood is the anchor. Parsons Electric needs eighteen Inside JW at **$44.80/hr** plus **$100/day** non-taxed per diem (Mon–Fri), bumping to **$150** weekends. That's 6-10's on a 100+ mile radius—solid, predictable work. Northern Valley's got four more Inside JW at the Air Base, same scale, **$75/day** incentive. This local is running clean, consistent data-center builds.

**LU-602 Amarillo, TX** — Six calls total but they're fat. Cache Valley and Rosendin are both staffing the CVE Llano data center project hard: twenty Inside JW slots each at **$52.30/hr**, plus per diem structured at **$58/58/50** (OT = DT) with **$40/day** zone pay. Rosendin's got eighteen of twenty positions still open in Claude. 6 a.m. report-in, drug test on entry. Work's heavy and the pay reflects it.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** — Thirty calls, one hundred twenty-five hands. HEART UTILITIES needs thirty-five Journeyman Lineman in Savannah at **$46.80/hr**, **$150/day** per diem, 5-10's. That's distribution backbone work, not specialty labor. Inception Energy's running substation tech at **$44.46/hr** statewide on 4-10's. This board's got volume and accessibility—good for holding book position while the high-dollar plays materialize elsewhere.

**LU-222 Orlando, FL** — Tiny board (four calls, four hands) but worth the drive if you're positioned right. Service Electric's got two substation groundman slots at **$150/hr**, **$150/day** per diem in Parrish and Ocoee. Travolt's matching it at **$150/hr** in Tavernier, same per diem. CDL-A required on all of it, but that rate is unmatched in the Southeast right now—storm or permanent, these calls have staying power.

Data-center build-out is the gravitational center: Amarillo, Grand Forks, and Memphis are running three- to four-month projects at scale. Alaska's feeder work is short-window, high-premium. Florida's substation surge is specialty-credential driven but paying premium for scarcity.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Monday, October 5, 2026**

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is the board to watch this week—six calls out, forty-one hands needed. Gem's got two separate plays: combo welders testing into a fab shop gig (no bennies pyramid, so read your contract), and pipefitters for 7-10s at the BDO fab shop who'll need current DISA certs. Graham's running Cenovus maintenance work with PD pyramiding hitting an extra $5/hr incentive for pipefitters—but you're getting current in DISA regardless. Nooter's also Cenovus with **$125/day** per diem incentive if you're a pipefitter. It's heavy cert work across the board; if you don't have DISA current, get mobile or wait it out.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** sits solid at six calls, twenty-nine hands. Kiewit's CWI position is the standout here at **$65/hr**, night shift with 15% differential—that's the rare spec job paying real money. US Eng. Metalworks wants stainless fitters and welders in-shop. Power Source at the Fort Lupton station needs combo welders with rigging cert. Trautman and Shreve's splitting swing shifts (2:30-1am) for two of three combo welder slots. Decent mixed bag of fab and field work.

**LU-213 St John, NB** is thin but live—five calls, five hands deep. Lake Utopia Paper is running two separate calls for F3/F4 welders (carbon stick and TIG testing required) and journeyman pipefitters on 4x10s. Irving Oil's shutdown work is heavier: CAM's got welder testing, Stuart Olson's pushing 6x10s. Shutdown premium usually moves fast; if you clear DISA testing, this board clears quick.

**LU-192 Cheyanne, WY** has one call: PMI's Fort Meade VA Hospital plumber slot (Sturgis, SD) with **$100/day** per diem, OSHA10 and background clearance mandatory. Medical gas cert required—niche credential, light board.

Refineries and shutdown work are pulling pipefitters and welders north into Canada and the High Plains; fab shops are stacking work across the Midwest. Certification depth matters more than ever.
